desc.zh: 每个数位上的数字按 0…9 循环：一次数完一整个数位，用 f(high) − f(low − 1) 相减；d = 0 时不计前导零。
desc.en: Each digit place cycles through 0…9: count a whole place at once, subtract f(high) − f(low − 1), and leave out leading zeros when d = 0.

complexity: O(log10 high) time: at most 9 place passes per prefix count for high <= 2*10^8, two prefix counts; O(1) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Prefix difference f(high) - f(low - 1)
concepts.description: Counting over low..high reduces to counting over 1..n twice.

concepts.name: Per-place cycle formula
concepts.description: At place p the digit cycles every 10p numbers: left*p complete blocks plus p, right+1 or 0 from the last block.

concepts.name: No leading zeros for d = 0
concepts.description: A zero needs a nonzero digit to its left: use (left - 1)*p and stop when left = 0.
